scope: Bounded additive supplement. All-bank duplicate comparison is not a claim that every pre-existing Current Affairs answer was freshly reverified.

baseline.sha256Scope: Ordered records containing id, pairId, kind, question, options and correctOptionIndex; not a raw-file hash. The complete original objects are independently pinned in tools/current-affairs-common.js.

verificationMethod: Primary/official web search results and selective page reads. Each item has two distinct named answer-supporting authorities and direct HTTPS evidence. Event-date wording prevents a past event being represented as an unqualified current status.
bankProtection: No existing question, answer, option order, ID, repetition count or importance flag changed. Append USR pairs at the tail. No past-paper provenance is claimed for the researched source items.
duplicateMethod: Exact normalized stems compared against all 11,892 baseline items; zero matches. Keyword/entity search covered stems and correct answers, followed by token-overlap candidates and manual fact/year/body comparison. Source/practice items within each pair test different facts.

semanticReview.decision: Existing questions concern award venue or 1901 winners; 2024 organization and its country are new.
The existing literature pair is for 2025, not the 2024 Han Kang award. Different award-year/winner facts.
Award venue and literature laureate are distinct from the 2025 Peace winner and her country.
Existing Nobel facts do not cover the 2025 Chemistry award topic or the Kitagawa/Robson/Yaghi trio.
Davos town draft was rejected as a semantic duplicate of the normal meeting venue. Replacement tests 2026 edition number; paired item tests that year's theme, neither the usual venue nor usual month.
Existing medicine pair is explicitly the 2018 immune-regulation award; new items test 2024 microRNA and its winners.
Existing agreement questions concern Paris climate agreement; new items concern WHO Pandemic Agreement adoption, not entry into force.
Astana Declaration is an SCO outcome; UN Pact for the Future and its digital annex are separate events/documents.
Existing climate-conference coverage includes COP26/COP30/COP31; COP29 venue and precise developed-country-led finance goal are new.
Older questions explicitly freeze BRICS membership in 2020. Indonesia's 2025 accession and Brazil's 2025 chairmanship are distinct.
Pakistan's 2017 accession is a different event. Belarus accession and the resulting July 2024 count are distinct facts.
Heads of Government meeting in Islamabad differs from Heads of State summits in Astana/Tianjin/Bishkek. Body distinction is explicit in stems and Urdu explanations.
2017 ICC final and 2016 Asian hockey tournament are distinct from the 2025 ICC Champions Trophy winner/runner-up.
Existing T20 items concern 2016 and 2009 editions; 2024 final winner and runner-up are separate event facts.
PIMEC Karachi venue and Environment Day theme are unrelated; Expo 2025 Osaka and its theme are absent.
Existing NASA acronym and Tianwen-1 mission questions do not test Europa Clipper's operator or target.
China's Mars mission is distinct from Chang'e-6 lunar sample return and its first far-side samples.
Pakistan PRSC-EO1 is distinct from the NASA-ISRO NISAR satellite, its partners and radar-observation purpose.
Existing G20 pair is 2023 India/New Delhi. New pair covers 2024 Rio and its anti-hunger alliance.
PRSC-EO1 imaging satellite differs from PAKSAT-MM1 communications satellite. Launch name and service purpose are distinct.

sourceCaveats: Armenia MFA reference for Belarus is used only for its July 2024 membership record, independently confirmed by the SCO. Unrelated background statements on that page are not copied.
WHO Pandemic Agreement questions ask adoption, not entry into force or universal national ratification.
COP29 US$300 billion goal is distinguished from the wider US$1.3 trillion mobilization ambition.
WEF 2026 edition and theme are supported by the event organizer and an official Saudi delegation statement; the original draft about the usual Davos venue was discarded.
Website fetch restrictions can affect an official page independently of its indexed evidence; references are not a guarantee of perpetual availability.
